about_us.headline:
Map your
professional direction.
about_us.desc_p1: Career Compass was born from a simple observation: students need clearer ways to connect academic preparation with available job requirements. The graduation project demonstrates CV parsing, skill extraction, matching, and source diagnostics.
about_us.v1_desc: We compare extracted CV skills and profile context with imported job requirements.
about_us.v2_desc: The system presents structured CV feedback with parsing status, confidence, and reviewable outputs.
about_us.v3_desc: Imported job data is shown with source diagnostics and honest source availability notes.
about_us.why_p1: The modern job market operates at light speed. Skills that were relevant two years ago are now foundational, and new domains emerge every season. Professionals are often left guessing what to learn next.
about_us.why_p2: We built Career Compass to reduce guesswork in a measurable academic demo. By combining NLP, normalized skills, imported jobs, and explainable gap analysis, the system helps students review possible gaps and next steps.

terms_page.title: Terms of Service
terms_page.s1_desc: Career Compass provides a graduation-project career guidance platform. By using the demo, you agree to provide accurate professional information for analysis. Misuse of scraping diagnostics or unauthorized access to the API is prohibited.
terms_page.s2_desc: The platform architecture, AI/NLP components, and branding are part of the CareerCompass graduation project repository and documentation.
terms_page.s3_desc: Career Compass provides guidance based on available CV/profile and imported job data. It does not guarantee employment, and users are responsible for verifying job details with employers.
terms_page.s4_desc: In no event shall Career Compass be liable for any indirect, incidental, or special damages arising from your professional career decisions based on our analysis.
terms_page.agree: By creating an account, you agree to these terms.
terms_page.notice_desc: We reserve the right to update these terms at any time. Major changes will be communicated via the email address registered with your Career Compass account.

privacy_page.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_page.s1_desc: We collect information you provide directly, including your resume data, employment history, and contact details necessary for our AI to perform gap analysis and job matching.
privacy_page.s2_title: 2. Use of AI and Data Processing
privacy_page.s2_desc: Your data is processed transiently by our AI microservices to generate match scores. We do not sell your personal data to third-party recruiters or advertisers.
privacy_page.s3_desc: The demo is designed with role-based access and privacy-aware CV handling, but production-grade security hardening is future work after graduation.
privacy_page.s4_desc: You can request deletion of account and CV data from the demo environment according to the project's documented data-handling process.
privacy_page.agree: Your privacy is a core architectural requirement.
privacy_page.notice_desc: For privacy questions in the graduation demo, contact the project team.
